page.overview:
What is Flowers and Fruit Mountain?

The mountain is located in the midst of the East Sea, across 200 miles of water west from the country of Aolai. It serves as the ancestral artery of the , and came into being after the creation of the universe. Up until the birth of Sun Wukong, there has always been an Immortal Stone on top of the mountain.

There are more than 72 caves in the large mountain, where many wild beasts reside in, with each cave ruled by a Demon King. Known caves include the Water Curtain Cave. Beasts living in the mountain include 47000 monkeys (including baboons, gibbons), loongs, wolves, insects, tigers, leopards, mouse deer, fallow deer, river deer, foxes, wild cats, badgers, lions, elephants, bears, antelopes, boars, muskoxen, chamois, green one-horn buffaloes, wild hares, giant mastiffs, lizards, civets.

Edible grass and shrubs grow on the mountain, as well as trees with fruits and mountain flowers. There are drinkable brooks and streams.
